key_insight: REGRID-QAOA reduces power-system islanding to a smaller physics-constrained quantum optimization problem, then uses post-processing to turn shallow QAOA samples into feasible high-quality islanding plans.
engineering_relevance: This enables grid operators and resilience planners to explore intentional islanding decisions with lower quantum resource demands while still respecting electrical feasibility constraints.
method: Coherency-informed graph reduction shrinks the grid before quantum optimization.
Physics-aware constraints are embedded into the QAOA formulation.
Structured post-processing converts sampled solutions into feasible islanding decisions.
evidence_signal: The framework was evaluated on IEEE 9-, 14-, 24-, 30-, 39-, and 57-bus test systems and achieved Gurobi-optimal solution quality with better quantum resource efficiency than vanilla QAOA.
watch_item: The approach depends on effective reduction and post-processing, so performance may vary when coherency structure or feasibility constraints are harder to preserve in larger real-world grids.
paper_title: REGRID-QAOA: A Resource-Efficient Graph-Reduced Hybrid QAOA Framework for Physics-Constrained Power System Islanding
